[[Spirit of Portals|Spirits of Portals]] guard [[Shiro Tagachi]]'s Spirit Rifts.

==Missions==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Sunjiang District}}

==Notes==
*Each Spirit of Portals maintains a Spirit Rift, each rift maintains Shiro's shield and summons a specific type of [[Shiro'ken]].
*As spirits, the Spirits of Portals can be instantly destroyed by [[Gaze of Fury]] and can be destroyed fairly quickly with [[Spiritual Pain]].
*Cannot be taken control of using [[Signet of Binding]].
